card.name: Inside the word quaternary in drug text
card.fires_on: The last part of 'quaternary' (or the 'am' of 'quaternary amine') in phrases about quaternary anticholinergics or ammonium compounds. Weaker on 'tertiary' and on charged-ion transporter terms.
